targetYaml:
version: 1
kind: target
name: lab1
core:
    amf: ${LAB_AMF}
    plmn:
        mcc: "208"
        mnc: "93"
    slices:
        - sst: 1
          sd: "010203"
subscribers:
    - name: main
      first_supi: "208930100007500"
      count: 10
      ki: ${ORBIT_KI}
      opc: ${ORBIT_OPC}
ran:
    n2_source_ips:
        - 127.0.0.1
        - 127.0.0.2
    n3_ips:
        - 127.0.0.1
    gnb_ids:
        first: 7
        bits: 24
runYaml:
# A fleet: the target's subscribers attached and kept for the run's
# duration (--for, default 5m), then deregistered. orbit test probes
# user-plane latency to the target's first responder's data_ip; a target
# with no responder runs the fleet idle. For other behaviours, copy it
# (orbit test --list fleet) into a run file and fill in behaviors. Gated
# on attach success at least 0.99.
kind: run
workloads:
  - name: fleet
    attach: {count: 2, rate: 10, concurrency: 64}
    behaviors: {}
gates:
  - name: attach_success_ratio
    slo: {metric: attach.success_ratio, op: ">=", threshold: "0.99"}
until: {duration: 2s}
